masked.basis: shipped hex, --masked-windows: cycles with SREG.I cleared in main-line code outside ISRs, from the cli (pc = its byte address) to the instruction that set I again (an ATOMIC_BLOCK's SREG restore counts); armed by the first sei (the reset -> sei stretch is initialisation, not a critical section); 280458 windows measured, the longest named

rule: measured = a recorded twin run with its inputs by sha256, the stimulus and the tool versions (reproducible-initial-conditions, 2026-09-26)

stimulus.describe: deterministic, cycle-scheduled, --free; 4 commands: pwm_duty 25, 50, 100 and led_on, with the TMP36 held at 750 mV (the ADC is read for every report)
drives: 4 commands: pwm_duty 25, 50, 100 and led_on, with the TMP36 held at 750 mV (the ADC is read for every report)
stimulus.name: uno-sim-rig/cyc0-v1

tools.simavr: libsimavr2 / simavr 1.6+dfsg-3 (Debian trixie), via polari-avr-twin in the image above (prf-board-engines/Dockerfile)

uart.chip_formula: 10 bit times x (8 if U2X else 16) x (UBRR+1) cycles (ATmega328P USART baud equations; the divisor is read from the build's own hal.c / board_config.h)
uart.note: the twin spaces bytes 3000 cycles apart, the chip 1360: the twin's send wait is 2.21x the chip's

what.functions: cycles per call, entry -> ret, in the -fno-inline build (atom as a node; includes everything it calls and any interrupt that landed inside); the caller's CALL (4 cycles) is not counted
what.isrs: cycles per interrupt, vector taken -> reti, in the shipped hex
what.loop: cycles between two visits of the loop's poll point, by the way the loop came back, in the shipped hex
what.masked: ipb-7: cycles with SREG.I cleared in main-line code outside ISRs (cli -> the instruction that set I again), per opening pc with its enclosing function, in the shipped hex
what.mean: a function's mean is not offered by the twin (n / min / max only); an interrupt's is
